scripts.dev: npm run build -w armstock-shared && concurrently -n "SHARED,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "yellow,cyan,magenta" "npm run dev -w armstock-shared" "npm run dev -w armstock-backend" "npm run dev -w armstock-frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run build -w armstock-shared && npm run lint -w armstock-backend && npm run lint -w armstock-frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w armstock-shared && npm run build -w armstock-backend && npm run build -w armstock-frontend
